title: The N-terminal Helix-Turn-Helix Motif of Transcription Factors MarA and Rob Drives DNA Recognition.
authors: Corbella, Marina; Liao, Qinghua; Moreira, Catia; Parracino, Antonietta; Kasson, Peter M; Kamerlin, Shina Caroline Lynn
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级全原子分子动力学模拟，解析转录因子MarA和Rob的N端HTH基序驱动DNA识别与结合模式转换的分子机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作动态机理，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: DNA-binding proteins play an important role in gene regulation and cellular function. The transcription factors MarA and Rob are two homologous members of the AraC/XylS family that regulate multidrug resistance. They share a common DNA-binding domain, and Rob possesses an additional C-terminal domain that permits binding of low-molecular weight effectors. Both proteins possess two helix-turn-helix (HTH) motifs capable of binding DNA; however, while MarA interacts with its promoter through both HTH-motifs, prior studies indicate that Rob binding to DNA via a single HTH-motif is sufficient for tight binding. In the present work, we perform microsecond time scale all-atom simulations of the binding of both transcription factors to different DNA sequences to understand the determinants of DNA recognition and binding. Our simulations characterize sequence-dependent changes in dynamical behavior upon DNA binding, showcasing the role of Arg40 of the N-terminal HTH-motif in allowing for specific tight binding. Finally, our simulations demonstrate that an acidic C-terminal loop of Rob can control the DNA binding mode, facilitating interconversion between the distinct DNA binding modes observed in MarA and Rob. In doing so, we provide detailed molecular insight into DNA binding and recognition by these proteins, which in turn is an important step toward the efficient design of antivirulence agents that target these proteins.
abstract_zh: DNA结合蛋白在基因调控和细胞功能中发挥重要作用。转录因子MarA和Rob是AraC/XylS家族中两个同源成员，调控多药耐药性。它们共享一个共同的DNA结合结构域，而Rob还拥有一个额外的C端结构域，允许结合低分子量效应物。这两种蛋白均具有两个能够结合DNA的螺旋-转角-螺旋（HTH）基序；然而，尽管MarA通过其两个HTH基序与其启动子相互作用，先前的研究表明，Rob通过单个HTH基序结合DNA足以实现紧密结合。在本工作中，我们进行了微秒时间尺度的全原子模拟，研究这两种转录因子与不同DNA序列的结合，以理解DNA识别和结合的决定因素。我们的模拟表征了DNA结合后动力学行为中序列依赖性的变化，展示了N端HTH基序中Arg40在实现特异性紧密结合中的作用。最后，我们的模拟证明，Rob的一个酸性C端环可以控制DNA结合模式，促进MarA和Rob中观察到的不同DNA结合模式之间的相互转换。通过这一研究，我们提供了这些蛋白与DNA结合和识别的详细分子见解，这反过来又是朝着高效设计靶向这些蛋白的抗毒力因子迈出的重要一步。
